name: Joanna
slug: New Navel market vendor who sells wicker animals.
description: Joanna is a living vendor in the New Navel market. She sells wicker animals, including a small wicker chicken and a one-to-one wicker goose, and says she can make geese or a gander.

log.summary: Gerk pays Joanna one gold for the small wicker chicken. She gives him directions to Haldor's house. Haldor later recognizes the chicken as hers and says she makes good geese.
